free_tier.stated: a free public HTML post listing AList sites, republished as a dated Jekyll permalink

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable; it is a list, not a service

retention.stated: the page is still served; the repository was last committed 2025-06-17 and the newest section is dated 23 March, so it stopped tracking new hosts well before that

tooling: plain HTML with one bare https:// host per line, so an extraction is a regex and not a parser
chaining: the only dated cohort available, and therefore the only way this topic can state a half-life at all

limits.value: the page is edited in place rather than republished, so its permalink date is not its content date

reliability_note: The permalink 20240120224502 reads as a publish date and is not one: the file at that path was committed 36 times, the first surviving revision is 2024-02-29 and the last is 2025-06-17.

evidence.proved: the page is served, the title is '分享一些基于Alist搭建的资源站合集', the author is 酷小呵, the meta published date is 2024-01-20T14:45:02Z, and the body begins '不定时更新中' with a section headed '3月23日新发现的alist资源站'
36 commits touch this path; the oldest returned is 2024-02-29T14:59:37Z and the newest is 2025-06-17T14:45:50Z, so the permalink is not a frozen snapshot
the 2024-02-29 revision contains 126 instance hostnames after noise removal, of which 11 still list mounts, giving 8.7% survival over 2.65 years

notes: The recon plan treated this page as a frozen 2024-01-20 snapshot and fitted a half-life to it. The commit history says otherwise: 36 commits touch this path, the earliest the API returned is 2024-02-29 and the last is 2025-06-17, and the page carries a section headed 3月23日新发现的alist资源站. The 144-host cohort as probed therefore mixes hosts first listed in 2024-01 with hosts added as late as mid-2025. Recomputing on the 126 hosts present in the earliest surviving revision gives 11 survivors, 8.7%, and a 9.0-month half-life against the 8.9 months the plan reported, so the conclusion survives the correction even though the method did not.
binding_note: The bias that matters is not the page dying but the page changing: hosts were added to a permalink after its date, so a survival rate computed from the URL's date overstates survival.
